title: ly05010419/MacNativeGames
why_read: A list/repo of games with native Mac support, useful as a reference but not a deep technical project itself.
analysis: This appears to be a curated repository tracking which games have native Apple Silicon or macOS support, likely compiled as a community reference list. It's useful for Mac gamers but has little inherent engineering depth, since it's primarily a dataset or list rather than original tooling. The value is informational rather than technical.
